question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Frenzy
solution:
The correct answer is 'Calm'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Frenzy is a noun that means a state or period of uncontrolled excitement or wild behaviour.
 
• The meanings of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Rage - violent uncontrollable anger (क्रोधोन्‍माद (उग्र क्रोध जिसे नियंत्रित करना कठिन हो)).
 
• Craze - enthusiasm for a particular activity or object which appears suddenly and achieves widespread but short-lived popularity (किसी बात में प्रायः अस्‍थायी या अल्‍पकालिक परंतु गहरी दिलचस्‍पी; सनक, धुन).
 
• Fury - wild or violent anger (रोष).
 
• Calm - not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions (शांत, चुपचाप).
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is evident that **C****a**lm is the correct antonym for the word Frenzy.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
